mechanism: Lock one original clearly adult subject with at least three identity anchors. Begin with one ordinary tactile task and show its completion. Use one natural foreground object, doorway or architectural edge to transition into a separate rest geometry. Hold long enough to show exactly one slow breath and at least two micro-responses in hair, clothing, plants or light while the camera performs only a restrained push. After the reset, let the same adult resume movement along an established direction and cross one visible exit threshold. The reusable mechanism is task completion, natural wipe, measured breathing reset, environmental micro-response and resumed exit—not the source woman, sheet, bicycle, bench, ferns, gate, clothing, exact camera, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Lock one clearly adult original subject and complete one ordinary tactile task before rest.
invariants.purpose: Gives stillness a before-state and purpose.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening directly on a bench becomes a generic portrait.

invariants.rule: Use one natural foreground or architectural edge to transition into a distinct rest geometry.
invariants.purpose: Connects active and quiet states without arbitrary cutting.
invariants.ablation_failure: A random dissolve loses spatial intention.

invariants.rule: Show exactly one slow breath and at least two micro-responses in body or environment.
invariants.purpose: Makes internal reset visible without melodrama.
invariants.ablation_failure: No micro-response looks frozen; many gestures overplay the moment.

invariants.rule: Restrict camera movement during the breath to one slow push or hold.
After rest, resume the same adult's movement and cross a visible exit threshold.
invariants.purpose: Proves renewal rather than terminal stillness.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on the bench leaves no change in agency.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source woman, face, hair, outfit and exact expressions
source white sheet, clips and outdoor task
source stairs, bicycle foreground wipe, bench and ferns
source park, brick gate, filtered light and exact route
source MiniMax H3 same-post wording, camera, timing and creator identity
